# Halcomb Optics - storefront configuration

The Halcomb Optics web shop runs on the platform's storefront service.

Two config layers apply: config/storefront-halcomb.json is the shop's instance config and config/platform-baseline.json is the platform defaults. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the defaults. A key in neither layer has no value at all.

turns.prompt: Halcomb Optics is updating its tax compliance page and needs the effective vat_display_mode of the UK storefront. What is it?
